# Candice Shen

> Candice Shen leads web marketing at Ramp. She holds an MBA from the Yale School of Management and previously worked in marketing at Microsoft, Materialize, Starburst and Attentive. This is her personal site, candiceshen.com.

## About

- Current role: leads web marketing at Ramp (ramp.com). The work spans conversion optimization, growth product management, web development, design, analytics, behavioral research and copywriting, and uses AI agents heavily.
- Education: MBA, Yale School of Management. B.S. in Media, Culture, and Communication, New York University.
- Earlier roles: product marketing MBA intern at Microsoft (Microsoft Security); account-based marketing at Materialize and at Starburst; growth marketing at Attentive.
- Background: grew up in Shanghai, based in New York City.
- Outside work: travel (28 countries; lived for months in Seoul and Prague) and building side projects with AI.

## Side projects

- [Listen, You Are Loved](https://candiceshen.com/listen-you-are-loved/): personalized spoken affirmations generated by an AI pipeline and mixed with music in the browser.
- [Competitive Battlecard AI](https://candiceshen.com/competitive-battlecard-ai/): turns a company URL into competitive battlecards for go-to-market teams.
- [Pocket Pitch Legends](https://pixel-perfect-capture-nine.vercel.app/): a location-based mobile web football game for the 2026 World Cup, built with a team of four.
